title: Summarize a multi-item security audit (hard)
prompt: Summarize the following in two sentences: The company's annual security audit uncovered two medium-severity vulnerabilities in the authentication service and one low-severity issue in the logging pipeline; the authentication vulnerabilities have already been patched and deployed to production, while the logging issue is scheduled for the next sprint since it poses no immediate risk, and a follow-up penetration test is planned for next quarter to confirm the fixes.

metadata.hard_reason: Long, dense sentence with multiple entities at different severities and timelines - easy to conflate 'already fixed' with 'scheduled' with 'planned'.
metadata.notes: Correct: two sentences correctly separating what's DONE (auth vulnerabilities patched/deployed) from what's SCHEDULED (logging issue, next sprint) from what's PLANNED (pen test, next quarter). Checking all three states are kept distinct.
metadata.grading_method: manual (reviewed 2026-09-23, V2.6 Phase 1) - explicitly NOT auto-gradeable by presence-checking: a response could mention every right keyword ('patched', 'scheduled', 'planned') while attributing them to the wrong item, which is exactly the failure mode this hard-flagged task exists to catch. A presence check would defeat the actual point of the test.
